result.topic_en: Riemann discusses the general case of a minimal surface bounded by straight lines, where the derivative of the Gauss map onto the sphere has branch points and logarithmic singularities. He specifies the singular behaviour of du/dt at the points t=a, b, c and derives a formula for du with conditions on the constants.
